name: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr
positioning: Fairmont Bab Al Bahr, a beach resort in Abu Dhabi with private sandy beaches and views of Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque
best_for: Travelers who want a beach stay with mosque views in Abu Dhabi
Families wanting suites with a kitchen or a villa with a private pool

facts.text: The hotel offers panoramas over Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.
The hotel is a 15 minute drive from Zayed International Airport.
The hotel is close to attractions on Yas Island, including Ferrari World and Warner Bros. World.
The hotel has private sandy beaches.
The hotel has 8 restaurants and bars.
Mazaj Bab Al Bahr is a restaurant at the hotel that serves The Emirati Table, a culinary journey.
Fairmont Gold is a hotel-within-a-hotel experience at the hotel.
The Fairmont Gold Lounge serves a complimentary continental breakfast, afternoon tea and evening drinks.
The Fairmont Villa has a private pool and gym facility amid a garden.
The Royal Suite has two custom designed bedrooms and a private dining area.
One Bedroom Suite View King with kitchen has a sea view, a dining area for 4 guests and a kitchen area with appliances.
The hotel hosts weddings in the Saqr Ballroom or in an open-air setting overlooking Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque.

Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
